name: news
description: 뉴스 영향 측정 — 뉴스 결과와 일봉을 받아 뉴스가 뜬 날의 주가 반응(D+1·D+5)을 대조군·벤치마크 대비로 잽니다. 수집은 naver-search, 해석은 대화 몫입니다.

actions.name: 뉴스일 주가 반응 측정 (D+1·D+5, 대조군 동반)
actions.description: News items (naver_search shape) + daily bars in -> per-news-day forward returns from the pre-news close, clustered by similar titles, with the all-days average as the control and optional benchmark-relative excess returns

actions.name: 보도량 타임라인·유사기사 묶기 (봉 불필요)
actions.description: News items in -> daily counts, clusters of near-duplicate titles, sources. No bars needed.

actions.name: 셀프테스트
actions.description: Offline checks with synthetic news and bars with known answers.

action.description: impact = news + daily bars -> measured reaction with a control. timeline = counts + clusters only. selftest = offline checks.

items.description: [impact/timeline] News rows as naver_search returns them: {title, link, description, pubDate}. Other shapes work if they carry a title and an RFC-2822 or ISO date field.

itemsCacheKey.description: [impact/timeline] The `_cacheKey` from the naver_search news call — hands the items over without re-inlining.

bars.description: [impact] Daily OHLCV rows of the stock, any broker dialect — a date-like field (date/time/stck_bsop_date/...) and a close-like field (close/clpr/stck_clpr/trade_price/...) are found by name.

benchmarkBars.description: [impact] Optional index daily bars (e.g. KOSPI) — enables benchmark-relative excess returns. Without it, raw returns are labeled as raw.

benchmarkBarsCacheKey.description: [impact] The `_cacheKey` from the index candle call.

horizons.description: [impact] Forward horizons in trading days. Default [1, 5].
